Yathā’ddakkhi.g: yathā addakkhi, tathā akkhāsi ācikkhi desesi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivari vibhaji uttānī-akāsi pakāsesi.
yathā sāmaṁ saccābhisambodhena asādhāraṇañāṇena ca addakkhi.

Yathā’ddakkhī.g: yathā sāmaṁ saccābhisambodhena asādhāraṇañāṇena ca addakkhi.

Yathā’gato.g: yenākārena āgato, amhehi anabbhito eva āgatoti attho.
yathā aviññātagatito ca anāmantetvā1 āgato tathā aviññātagatiko ananuññātova gato.
āgacchantopi yathā attanova ruciyā āgato, gacchantopi tatheva gato.

Yathā’gata.g: yenākārena āgato, amhehi anabbhito eva āgatoti attho.
āgacchantopi yathā attanova ruciyā āgato, gacchantopi tatheva gato.

Yathā’ssa.g: assa yogino yathā tattha abhijjhādayo nappavattanti, evaṁ aniccādito rūpaṁ passantassa.

Yathā’sā’si.g: yathāssa pitu santikā sutaṁ āsi, tatheva addasa, “yathāssāsī”tipi3 pāṭho.
